prompt: Implement a scheduled task that escalates overdue policy reviews. Notify managers. Create audit trail.
spec_yaml:
task_id: scheduled-policy-review-escalation
summary: "Implement a scheduled task to escalate overdue policy reviews, notify managers, and create an audit trail"
depends_on: ["stage-1-core-models", "stage-2-notifications"]
local_goals:
  - id: L1
    description: "INSPECT: check existing policy review model and routes before adding endpoints"
    verification:
      type: file_exists
      path: "src/models/PolicyReview.ts"
      expect:
        exists: true
  - id: L2
    description: "CREATE: add scheduled task to escalate overdue policy reviews"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "pnpm build --filter=@verified-attention/api"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
  - id: L3
    description: "CREATE: add notification logic for managers when a review is escalated"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "pnpm build --filter=@verified-attention/notifications"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
  - id: L4
    description: "CREATE: create an audit trail for policy review escalations"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "pnpm build --filter=@verified-attention/api"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
  - id: L5
    description: "VERIFY: Scheduled task correctly identifies overdue reviews and sends notifications"
    verification:
      type: http
      method: GET
      url: http://localhost:3000/api/escalate-reviews
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {{test_token}}"
      expect:
        status: 200
        json_schema:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              reviewId: { type: string }
              managerEmail: { type: string }
            required: [reviewId, managerEmail]
  - id: L6
    description: "VERIFY: Audit trail is created for each escalated policy review"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "pnpm test --filter=@verified-attention/api -- --testPathPattern=audit-trail"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
global_goals_refs: ["G5", "G13"]
context:
  language: TypeScript
  framework: Express
  orm: Prisma
  test_framework: Vitest
validation_errors: Goals L2 and L4: near-duplicate verification (type=cli, same target). Each goal should verify a distinct aspect.
